# mockingbird_api_key (Resource)

A workspace API key, for example a `data-plane` key an application sends to mocks with `data_plane_auth.mode = "api_key"`. The token is shown once, at creation; it is stored in the Terraform state as a sensitive value, so keep the state encrypted. Every change replaces the key (revoking the old one). The Admin API does not let an API key create keys: the provider must authenticate as a user (an OIDC access token) or the server must run with `auth.mode: none`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A key the staging app sends to mocks with data_plane_auth.mode = "api_key".
resource "mockingbird_api_key" "app" {
  name   = "staging-app"
  role   = "viewer"
  scopes = ["data-plane"]
}

# Hand the token to the app's secret store rather than printing it.
output "app_key" {
  value     = mockingbird_api_key.app.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key name, 1–128 characters.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Expiry time (RFC 3339); unset never expires.
- `role` (String) `viewer` (default), `editor`, `admin` or `owner`; at most the caller's own role.
- `scopes` (List of String) `admin` (the Admin API) and/or `data-plane` (calls to mocks with `api_key` data-plane auth). Default `["admin"]`.
- `sysadmin` (Boolean) Acts as a sysadmin; only a sysadmin can create such a key.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace of the resource. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `created_by` (String) Subject of the principal that created the key.
- `id` (String) Identifier, `<workspace>/<key_id>`; also the import ID.
- `key_id` (String) The key's public id.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The secret token, `mbk_<key_id>_<secret>`. Only known for keys created by this resource (null after import).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An API key is imported as <workspace>/<key_id>; its token is not
# retrievable, so it is null after import.
terraform import mockingbird_api_key.app default/q3vx7kd2m4ab
```
